name: abap-cleaner-vscode-dev
description: Automated ABAP cleaner formatting and linting.

commands.title: ABAP Cleaner: Disable Rule for This Workspace

abapCleaner.abapRelease.description: Optional target ABAP release used to gate release-sensitive cleanup rules.

abapCleaner.lint.enabled.description: Publish diagnostics for cleanup rules that would change the document.

abapCleaner.lint.run.description: When to refresh ABAP Cleaner diagnostics.

abapCleaner.trace.description: Diagnostic logging to the ABAP Cleaner output channel (ABAP Cleaner: Show Log).

abapCleaner.rangeFormatting.expandMode.description: Code boundary expanded by Format Selection; FULL_CONTROL_BLOCK selects the innermost IF, loop, CASE, TRY, SELECT, or PROVIDE block, and FULL_CLASS also covers interface blocks.

abapCleaner.rules.CDS_TEST_CLASS_LINES.e.markdownDescription:
**Standardize test classes for CDS views**

Currently removes exact generated ABAP Doc instructions and TODO comments before simple populated VALUE constructors in annotated local CDS test classes.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_LINES_IN_CLASS_D.markdownDescription:
**Standardize empty lines in class definitions**

Currently limits consecutive blank lines inside non-deferred class definitions.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_LINES_IN_CLASS_D.description: Override: Maximum consecutive blank lines in class definitions.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_LINES_OUTSIDE_ME.markdownDescription:
**Separate methods and classes with empty lines**

Currently standardizes blank lines directly between class and interface blocks.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_LINES_OUTSIDE_ME.description: Override: Blank lines between classes or interfaces.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_LINES_WITHIN_MET.markdownDescription:
**Standardize empty lines within methods**

Limits consecutive blank lines inside METHOD and ENDMETHOD blocks.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_LINES_WITHIN_MET.description: Override: Maximum consecutive blank lines within methods.

abapCleaner.rules.ONE_COMMAND_PER_LINE.e.markdownDescription:
**Move commands to own lines**

Currently splits consecutive simple, uncommented same-line commands while retaining the existing indent.

abapCleaner.rules.CLOSING_BRACKETS_POSIT.markdownDescription:
**Close brackets at line end**

Currently moves isolated closing parentheses and brackets to the preceding non-comment line.

abapCleaner.rules.NEEDLESS_SPACES.enable.markdownDescription:
**Remove needless spaces**

Currently removes excess same-line whitespace from empty parentheses and brackets.

abapCleaner.rules.NEEDLESS_SPACES.proces.description: Override: Remove multiple spaces from empty parentheses and brackets.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACES_IN_EMPTY_BRACKE.markdownDescription:
**Put spaces around text literals**

Adds missing spaces between text literals and keywords, operators, or comments.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACES_IN_EMPTY_BRACKE.description: Override: Add space between keywords and text literals.
Override: Add space between operators and text literals.
Override: Add space between text literals and comments.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACE_BEFORE_PERIOD.en.markdownDescription:
**Remove space before commas and period**

Removes same-line spaces before chain commas and statement periods.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACE_BEFORE_PERIOD.ex.description: Override: Remove space before chain commas.
Override: Remove space before statement periods.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACE_AROUND_COMMENT_S.markdownDescription:
**Put spaces around " comment sign**

Ensures at least one space before and after a line-end " comment sign.

abapCleaner.rules.SPACE_AROUND_COMMENT_S.description: Override: Separate code and " comment with a space.
Override: Start " comment with a space.

abapCleaner.rules.LOCAL_DECLARATION_ORDE.markdownDescription:
**Reorder local declarations**

Currently only relocates a simple, non-chained, comment-free CONSTANTS name TYPE simple-type VALUE literal. declaration found anywhere in a method/form/function body to immediately after the last already-correctly-positioned leading CONSTANTS declaration, preserving relative order; TYPES/STATICS/DATA/FIELD-SYMBOLS grouping and reordering by first use are not yet handled. Refuses the whole body if it contains a BEGIN OF structured declaration or a dynamic ASSIGN.

abapCleaner.rules.CLASS_DEFINITION.enabl.markdownDescription:
**Standardize CLASS ... DEFINITION**

Currently orders PUBLIC before FINAL in a simple one-line comment-free class definition.

abapCleaner.rules.ABAP_DOC_PARAMETERS.en.markdownDescription:
**Add missing parameters to ABAP Doc**

Currently adds one parameter entry to a non-synchronized single-line ABAP Doc header above a simple METHODS IMPORTING declaration.

abapCleaner.rules.ESCAPE_CHAR_FOR_PARAMS.markdownDescription:
**Standardize escaping of !parameters**

Currently adds or removes ! for one critical or noncritical parameter in a simple one-line METHODS IMPORTING declaration.

abapCleaner.rules.NEEDLESS_CLEAR.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Remove needless CLEAR**

Currently removes an uncommented CLEAR immediately following a declared scalar local variable.

abapCleaner.rules.IMPLICIT_TYPE.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Make implicit type explicit**

Currently expands standalone uncommented untyped and name(length) DATA and TYPES declarations.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_SECTIONS.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Remove empty class definition SECTIONs**

Currently removes empty uncommented visibility SECTIONs from final local class definitions.

abapCleaner.rules.ABAP_DOC_LANG.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Remove lang="en" from ABAP Doc**

Removes the English language attribute from synchronized ABAP Doc shorttexts.

abapCleaner.rules.CHAIN_OF_ONE.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Simplify a chain with one element**

Currently removes the colon from simple single-line chains with one element.

abapCleaner.rules.DECLARATION_CHAIN.enab.markdownDescription:
**Unchain into multiple statements**

Currently unchains two-item, one-line comment-free DATA and TYPES declarations with simple TYPE names.

abapCleaner.rules.UNUSED_PARAMETERS.enab.markdownDescription:
**Report unused parameters**

Currently adds a TODO comment for an IMPORTING parameter never referenced (by word-token text, including in comments) in the body of a non-chained METHODS declaration with only simple parameter type clauses, skipping methods with no executable statement in their body and parameters marked ##NEEDED; EXPORTING, CHANGING, and RETURNING parameters, and removing stale TODO comments, are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.UNUSED_VARIABLES.enabl.markdownDescription:
**Delete unused variables**

Currently deletes a standalone declared scalar variable only when its name never occurs again anywhere in its method, including in comments.

abapCleaner.rules.FINAL_VARIABLE.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Use FINAL for immutable variables**

Currently replaces DATA( ) with FINAL( ) for a plain-assignment inline declaration that is read again but never reassigned, skipping methods that mention ASSIGNING, REF, FIELD-SYMBOL, or ASSIGN.

Requires ABAP release 757 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_ABAP_DOC.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Align ABAP Doc**

Currently right-pads the keyword and name columns of "! @parameter/@raising/@exception <name> | <text> ABAP Doc lines for a run of more than one such line, stopping at the first non-"!-prefixed token; a run immediately followed by another comment (rather than the declaration it documents) is left untouched.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_METHODS_REDEFINI.markdownDescription:
**Align METHODS ... REDEFINITION**

Currently aligns the METHODS/name columns for a run of at least two consecutive single-line, non-chained METHODS <name> REDEFINITION. statements, using the same alignment engine as ALIGN_ASSIGNMENTS; the FINAL REDEFINITION variant, a chained METHODS: declaration, a trailing comment, and a statement spanning more than one line are not recognized and break the run.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_METHODS_FOR_TEST.markdownDescription:
**Align METHODS ... FOR TESTING**

Currently aligns the METHODS/name/FOR columns for a run of at least two consecutive single-line, non-chained METHODS <name> FOR TESTING. statements, using the same alignment engine as ALIGN_ASSIGNMENTS; ABSTRACT, RAISING, a chained METHODS: declaration, a trailing comment, and a statement spanning more than one line are not recognized and break the run.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_DECLARATIONS.ena.markdownDescription:
**Align declarations**

Currently aligns DATA/CONSTANTS/FIELD-SYMBOLS declarations of the simple shape <name> TYPE <single-token-type> [VALUE <single-token-value>]. either across a run of at least two consecutive, non-chained declarations sharing the same keyword and VALUE-presence, or independently within one chained declaration; TYPES, BEGIN OF/END OF structures, LIKE, LENGTH/DECIMALS/READ-ONLY, a multi-token VALUE, a trailing comment, and a multi-line declaration are not recognized.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_LOGICAL_EXPRESSI.markdownDescription:
**Align logical expressions**

Currently aligns a flat chain of comparisons after IF/ELSEIF/CHECK/WHILE, joined only by AND or only by OR (never mixed), where every comparison uses the same single-character-or-two symbolic operator (=, <>, <, >, <=, >=) with a single-token left- and right-hand side and each condition after the first is on its own source line; the triggering keyword line itself is left untouched. NOT, parentheses, EQUIV, predicate expressions (IS INITIAL/IS BOUND/IN/BETWEEN), keyword-style operators (EQ/NE/...), mixed operator widths, and WHERE/ON/HAVING/WHEN SQL contexts are not recognized.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_SELECT_CLAUSES.e.markdownDescription:
**Align SELECT clauses**

Currently repositions FROM/WHERE/GROUP BY/HAVING/ORDER BY/INTO/APPENDING onto their own line at SELECT-column+2 for an already-multi-line, single-query OpenSQL SELECT statement (matching the default "keep existing" one-liner policy: an already single-line statement is left untouched); a FROM already glued to the SELECT line with no JOIN is left as-is. UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT, subqueries, FOR ALL ENTRIES, %_HINTS, and the SELECT...ENDSELECT loop form are not recognized and refuse the whole statement; no column/value alignment is performed.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_SELECT_LISTS.ena.markdownDescription:
**Align SELECT lists**

Currently repositions a SELECT field list onto one field per line, hang-indented to the first field's column, when every field is "complex" (more than one token, e.g. a function call or an AS addition, or a single tilde-qualified token such as t1~col) matching a conservative subset of upstream's default classification; a list mixing simple (bare, non-tilde) and complex fields, a single-field list, or an already single-line statement is left untouched. Also left-pads each field's name so a trailing AS alias lines up in a shared column across fields (a field with no AS is not padded itself, but its width still counts toward that shared column); a nested AS inside a function call is not mistaken for the field's own alias.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_WITH_SECOND_WORD.markdownDescription:
**Align keywords with second word of first line**

Currently repositions WITH/INTO/ASSIGNING/WHERE continuation keywords (each starting its own source line) to the column of a READ or LOOP statement's own second word (e.g. TABLE in READ TABLE, AT in LOOP AT), when that second word is on the same line as READ/LOOP; AND/OR/EQUIV are never repositioned. An include list of just READ/LOOP is used in place of upstream's much longer exclude list, since both are unambiguous internal-table/loop operations with no Open-SQL homonym; other trigger keywords (INSERT/DELETE/MODIFY/EXPORT/IMPORT/SUBMIT/etc.) are not recognized.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_COND_EXPRESSIONS.markdownDescription:
**Align conditional expressions**

Currently splits a COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... [ELSE ...] ) constructor expression with exactly one WHEN branch onto separate WHEN/THEN/ELSE lines, each hang-indented to WHEN's own column, when the expression already spans more than one source line; an already single-line expression is left untouched. SWITCH, a LET ... IN prefix, a multi-WHEN (tabular) expression, and any comment inside the parentheses are not recognized and refuse the whole expression; the THEN/ELSE value content itself is never touched.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_ALIASES_FOR.enab.markdownDescription:
**Align ALIASES ... FOR ...**

Currently aligns the ALIASES/identifier/FOR columns for a run of at least two consecutive non-chained ALIASES <name> FOR <target>. statements to the widest cell in each column, using the same alignment engine as ALIGN_ASSIGNMENTS; a chained ALIASES: declaration or a statement with a trailing comment is not recognized and breaks the run.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_CLEAR_FREE_AND_S.markdownDescription:
**Align CLEAR:/FREE: chains**

Currently only breaks a CLEAR: or FREE: chain of plain-identifier items (no additions) onto its own lines, each indented to the column of the first item; SORT ... BY and CATCH chains are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.ALIGN_ASSIGNMENTS.enab.markdownDescription:
**Align assignments to the same object**

Currently right-pads the identifier column and right-aligns the operator column (=, +=, -=, *=, /=, ?=, &&=) for a run of at least two consecutive simple assignments to the same structure variable (the text before an identifier's last "-"; a plain identifier with no "-" never groups with anything); the full multi-column AlignTable engine, other alignable command shapes, and the remaining 16 upstream ALIGN_* rules are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.CAMEL_CASE_IN_CDS_TEST.markdownDescription:
**Use CamelCase in test class for CDS view**

Currently adds CI_NOWHERE only to exact SELECT statements of the annotated CDS test view.

abapCleaner.rules.IF_BLOCK_AT_LOOP_END.e.markdownDescription:
**Replace long IF blocks at loop end**

Currently converts a final single-command IF operand IS INITIAL loop block to an early CONTINUE guard.

abapCleaner.rules.IF_BLOCK_AT_METHOD_END.markdownDescription:
**Replace long IF blocks at method end**

Currently converts a final single-command IF operand IS INITIAL block to an early RETURN guard.

abapCleaner.rules.UPPER_AND_LOWER_CASE.e.markdownDescription:
**Convert upper and lower case**

Currently uppercases only recognized standalone statement-leading keywords.

abapCleaner.rules.COMMENT_TYPE.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Comment with " instead of * for prose**

Currently converts only unambiguous column-one prose asterisk comments and preserves code-shaped comments.

abapCleaner.rules.CONDENSE.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace CONDENSE with string function**

Currently replaces adjacent declared scalar CONDENSE statements.

Requires ABAP release 702 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.STRING_TEMPLATE.enable.markdownDescription:
**Use string templates to assemble text**

Currently converts safe backtick literal and identifier concatenations in simple assignments.

Requires ABAP release 702 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.ASSERT_PARAMETER_ORDER.markdownDescription:
**Standardize assertion parameter order**

Currently places EXP before ACT in two-argument scalar assert_equals calls.

abapCleaner.rules.ASSERT_CLASS.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Use assert class instead of ASSERT**

Currently converts simple one-line bound, initial, scalar comparison, ABAP boolean, and sy-subrc ASSERT predicates to a configurable assert class.

abapCleaner.rules.ASSERT_CLASS.assertCla.description: Override: Class called for converted assertions.

abapCleaner.rules.DESCRIBE_TABLE.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace DESCRIBE TABLE ... LINES with lines( )**

Currently replaces exact uncommented DESCRIBE TABLE ... LINES statements immediately before RETURN.

abapCleaner.rules.TRANSLATE.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace TRANSLATE with string functions**

Currently replaces adjacent declared scalar TRANSLATE ... TO UPPER or LOWER CASE statements.

Requires ABAP release 702 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.TYPO.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Correct frequent typos**

Currently corrects an embedded unambiguous subset of frequent typos in comments only.

abapCleaner.rules.NEEDLESS_PARENTHESES.e.markdownDescription:
**Remove needless parentheses**

Currently removes one outer pair around single-line operand IS INITIAL predicates in selected logical statements.

abapCleaner.rules.PRAGMA_POSITION.enable.markdownDescription:
**Move pragmas to correct position**

Currently moves one complete, uncommented trailing pragma before a statement period.

abapCleaner.rules.END_OF_COMMENT.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Remove end-of comments**

Currently removes trailing METHOD, FORM, and FUNCTION end comments that exactly repeat the paired name.

abapCleaner.rules.CHECK_IN_LOOP.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Convert CHECK in loop to IF NOT ... CONTINUE**

Currently converts single-line operand IS INITIAL checks in complete LOOP, DO, and WHILE blocks.

abapCleaner.rules.CHECK_OUTSIDE_LOOP.ena.markdownDescription:
**Convert CHECK outside loop to IF NOT ... RETURN**

Currently converts single-line operand IS INITIAL checks in complete procedures when no loop encloses them.

abapCleaner.rules.EXIT_OUTSIDE_LOOP.enab.markdownDescription:
**Replace EXIT outside loop with RETURN**

Currently converts bare EXIT statements inside complete methods, functions, and forms when no loop encloses them.

abapCleaner.rules.EQUALS_SIGN_CHAIN.enab.markdownDescription:
**Resolve equals sign chain into several commands**

Currently splits one-line chains of plain identifiers with a simple final value.

abapCleaner.rules.PSEUDO_COMMENT.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace obsolete pseudo comments with pragmas**

Currently converts an embedded unambiguous subset of complete trailing pseudo-comments; requires ABAP 7.02 or later.

Requires ABAP release 702 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.RECEIVING_KEYWORD.enab.markdownDescription:
**Omit RECEIVING**

Currently converts simple one-line method calls with only a simple RECEIVING parameter.

abapCleaner.rules.EMPTY_COMMAND.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Remove standalone empty commands**

Currently removes standalone punctuation-only command lines while retaining trailing quote comments.

abapCleaner.rules.ADD_TO_ETC.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace obsolete ADD TO etc. with calculation assignment**

Currently converts simple one-line ADD, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY, and DIVIDE statements; requires ABAP 7.54 or later.

Requires ABAP release 754 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.RAISE_TYPE.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace RAISE TYPE with RAISE NEW**

Currently converts simple one-line RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE and RAISE SHORTDUMP TYPE statements; requires ABAP 7.52 or later.

Requires ABAP release 752 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.CREATE_OBJECT.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace CREATE OBJECT with NEW constructor**

Currently converts simple one-line static CREATE OBJECT statements without parameters; requires ABAP 7.40 or later.

Requires ABAP release 740 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.MOVE_TO.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace obsolete MOVE TO with =**

Currently converts simple one-line MOVE source TO destination statements.

abapCleaner.rules.CALCULATION_ASSIGNMENT.markdownDescription:
**Prefer calculation assignment operators**

Currently converts direct one-line identifier = identifier operator value assignments; requires ABAP 7.54 or later.

Requires ABAP release 754 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.ASSERT_EQUALS_SUBRC.en.markdownDescription:
**Use assert_subrc instead of assert_equals**

Currently simplifies one-line assert_equals calls with exactly act = sy-subrc and a simple numeric exp value.

abapCleaner.rules.ASSERT_EQUALS_BOOLEAN..markdownDescription:
**Use assert_true and assert_false**

Currently simplifies one-line assert_equals calls with exactly act and boolean exp parameters, including nested functional act expressions.

abapCleaner.rules.CALL_METHOD.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace CALL METHOD with functional call**

Currently modernizes simple one-line static calls with existing or empty argument lists.

abapCleaner.rules.EXPORTING_KEYWORD.enab.markdownDescription:
**Omit optional EXPORTING**

Currently removes EXPORTING from simple single-line method calls with no other sections.

abapCleaner.rules.COMPARISON_OPERATOR.en.markdownDescription:
**Use consistent set of comparison operators**

Currently converts textual operators in simple logical control statements.

abapCleaner.rules.NOT_IS.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Prefer IS NOT to NOT IS**

Transforms simple single-line NOT operand IS predicates.

abapCleaner.rules.LOGICAL_OPERATOR_POSIT.markdownDescription:
**Move AND/OR etc. from line end to next line start**

Currently moves terminal AND, OR, EQUIV, and selected LOOP or DELETE WHERE keywords to the next line.

abapCleaner.rules.SELF_REFERENCE_ME.enab.markdownDescription:
**Remove the self-reference me->**

Currently removes attached me-> only from direct method calls, never from attribute access.

abapCleaner.rules.READ_TABLE.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Replace READ TABLE with table expression**

Currently replaces simple one-line READ TABLE WITH KEY ... ASSIGNING statements with ASSIGN table expressions.

Requires ABAP release 740 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.VALUE_STATEMENT.enable.markdownDescription:
**Shorten VALUE statements**

Currently factors one shared scalar assignment from exactly two simple one-line VALUE rows.

Requires ABAP release 740 or later.

abapCleaner.rules.INSET.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Indent lines**

Currently reindents the leading line of each recognized command (and its attached leading comments) to match IF/CASE/DO/WHILE/LOOP/TRY/SELECT/PROVIDE and CLASS/INTERFACE/METHOD/FORM/FUNCTION nesting depth; leaves chained same-line statements and multi-line continuation lines untouched.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_EMPTY_LINES_WITHIN.markdownDescription:
**Standardize empty lines within sections**

Currently only caps consecutive blank lines to at most one and trims blank lines at document end; does not yet classify DDL sections (parameters, joins, associations, select list).

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_SPACES_AROUND_SIGN.markdownDescription:
**Standardize spaces around colon, comma etc.**

Currently standardizes comma spacing and //-- line-end comment marker spacing only; colon and arithmetic-operator spacing are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_SPACES_AROUND_BRAC.markdownDescription:
**Standardize spaces around brackets**

Currently standardizes spacing around [ ] cardinality and path-expression brackets only; parentheses ( ) for functions, ABAP types, and arithmetics are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_POSITION_BRACES.en.markdownDescription:
**Break before select list braces**

Currently only enforces a line break with no indent before the opening and closing brace of each top-level select list; configurable break modes/indents and the legacy brace-less SELECT...FROM syntax are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_POSITION_CLAUSES.e.markdownDescription:
**Break before WHERE clause etc.**

Currently only enforces a line break with no indent before top-level WHERE, HAVING, GROUP BY, UNION [ALL], INTERSECT, and EXCEPT keywords, condensing a split GROUP BY/UNION ALL phrase onto one line; forcing an extra blank line before UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT and re-indenting a multi-line condition after its keyword moves are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_POSITION_SELECT.en.markdownDescription:
**Break before AS SELECT etc.**

Currently only enforces a line break with indent 2 before "AS SELECT [DISTINCT] FROM", "AS PROJECTION ON", and "{EXCEPT|INTERSECT|UNION [ALL]} SELECT [DISTINCT] FROM", condensing each phrase onto one line; breaking before the data source and the extra blank line after WITH PARAMETERS (...) are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_POSITION_DEFINE.en.markdownDescription:
**Break before DEFINE etc.**

Currently only enforces a line break with no indent before the first top-level DEFINE/EXTEND/ANNOTATE keyword, condensing the following structural-keyword phrase up to the entity name (via a fixed keyword list, not full entity-name pattern matching) onto one line, and breaks before a top-level WITH PARAMETERS at indent 2, condensing that phrase; joining an already-broken entity name, forcing a blank line before DEFINE/EXTEND/ANNOTATE, re-indenting each parameter, and ROLE/ACCESSPOLICY declarations are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_EMPTY_LINES_BETWEE.markdownDescription:
**Standardize empty lines between sections**

Currently only enforces at least one blank line between trailing annotations and DEFINE/EXTEND/ANNOTATE, before/after the select list braces, and no blank line directly after { or before }, without ever creating a break where none exists; the boundaries around JOIN, ASSOCIATION, and WITH PARAMETERS (...) are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_ANNO_LAYOUT.enable.markdownDescription:
**Standardize annotation layout**

Currently only condenses an annotation's dotted path onto one contiguous run with no internal whitespace and standardizes spacing around every colon (no space before, one space after, unless already followed by a line break); nesting depth/order, one-liner detection, value/table alignment, and inner brace/bracket spacing are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_ANNO_NESTING.enabl.markdownDescription:
**Rearrange annotations**

Currently nests a run of 5 or more CONSECUTIVE simple annotations (@path: single-token-value, no existing {}/[] structure, no trailing comment) sharing an exact parent path of 3 or more segments into one @parentPath: { name: value, ... } annotation, always written multi-line (never collapsed to one line, matching default behavior only for runs at or above the 5-member threshold where a one-liner is never a candidate regardless of width) with member names column-padded and continuation lines hanging-indented to the brace column. Fewer than 5 siblings, a parent path shorter than 3 segments, a gap (blank line or comment) between candidates, non-adjacent same-prefix annotations, deeper nesting, and all sort-order/empty-line/allow-block-list configuration are not recognized.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_POSITION_JOIN.enab.markdownDescription:
**Break before JOINs**

Currently enforces a line break at indent 4 before every top-level JOIN keyword phrase, condensing it onto one line, and forces a break before ON at indent 6 for every JOIN in the file if any of them already has a multi-line condition (matching the file-wide default); the WITH DEFAULT FILTER clause, breaking before the data source, and re-indenting a multi-line condition's continuation lines are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_POSITION_ASSOCIATI.markdownDescription:
**Break before ASSOCIATIONs**

Currently enforces a line break at indent 2 before every top-level ASSOCIATION/COMPOSITION keyword phrase (including its cardinality bracket), condensing it onto one line, and forces a break before ON at indent 4 for every ASSOCIATION in the file if any of them already has a multi-line condition (matching the file-wide default); the WITH DEFAULT FILTER clause, breaking before the data source, and re-indenting a multi-line condition's continuation lines are not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_ALIGN_ENTITY_PARAM.markdownDescription:
**Align view parameters**

Currently enforces indent 4 and left-pads the name/colon columns of a WITH PARAMETERS clause when every parameter has the simple shape <name> : <single-token-type>; an annotation directly above a parameter is left untouched, and a single parameter with a multi-token type (e.g. abap.char( 10 )) cancels alignment for the whole clause rather than misreading it.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_ALIGN_SOURCE_PARAM.markdownDescription:
**Align source parameters**

Currently left-pads the name/colon columns of parameters passed to a parameterized data source (select from/join/on Entity( P_Param : value, ... )) when every parameter has the simple shape <name> : <single-token-value> and each is on its own source line; a dotted path like $parameters.P_AnyParam counts as one token, but a multi-token value (e.g. an arithmetic expression) cancels alignment for the whole clause; repositioning the opening parenthesis or the AS <alias> after the closing parenthesis is not yet handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_ALIGN_LOGICAL_EXPR.markdownDescription:
**Align logical expressions**

Currently aligns a flat chain of comparisons in a top-level JOIN/ASSOCIATION ON condition, joined only by AND or only by OR (never mixed), where every comparison uses the same single-token symbolic operator (=, <>, <, >, <=, >=) with a single-token left- and right-hand side and each condition after the first is on its own source line; the ON line itself is left untouched. WHERE/HAVING/WHEN/path-expression-filter conditions, NOT, parentheses, predicate expressions, and mixed operator widths are not recognized.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_ALIGN_FUNCTION_PAR.markdownDescription:
**Align function parameters**

Currently left-pads the name/=> columns of a CDS built-in function call's named parameters (e.g. currency_conversion( amount => a, source_currency => b )) when every parameter has the simple shape <name> => <single-token-value> and each is on its own source line; a nested function call aligns independently of its enclosing call. A single parameter with a multi-token value cancels alignment for the whole call rather than skipping just that parameter (stricter than upstream, which skips only the non-matching parameter); repositioning the opening/closing parenthesis is not handled.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_ALIGN_FIELD_LISTS..markdownDescription:
**Align field lists**

Currently forces a GROUP BY field list of 2+ fields onto one field per line, hang-indented to the first field's own column, unconditionally (matching upstream's default, which does not gate on field complexity or existing one-line layout); a function call's internal commas do not split fields. The DDIC-view parenthesized name list (this rule's other upstream target), comment re-indentation, and comma-spacing normalization are not handled; the first field's own position/indent (upstream's GroupByListPos) is not repositioned.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_ALIGN_DATA_SOURCES.markdownDescription:
**Align data sources**

Currently left-pads the data-source name across a FROM clause and its JOIN/ASSOCIATION phrases so each row's AS alias (and, when on the same source line, ON condition) lines up in a shared column; a data source with no alias is not padded itself, but its width still counts toward the shared column. The JOIN/ASSOCIATION keyword phrase itself is not aligned into its own column (already positioned by DDL_POSITION_JOIN/DDL_POSITION_ASSOCIATION); an AS alias or ON condition already on its own separate source line is left untouched rather than merged upward. A run of fewer than 2 data sources, or one whose data source doesn't reduce to a simple name (optionally parameterized) plus AS alias, is left untouched.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_ALIGN_SELECT_LIST..markdownDescription:
**Align select list**

Currently left-pads each select-list element (a KEY/VIRTUAL prefix, if present, is folded into the element itself rather than its own column) so every element's AS alias lines up in a shared column; an element with no alias is not padded itself, but its width still counts toward the shared column. Requires the list to already be one element per line (refuses if any two elements share a source line) and refuses the whole list if any element contains a comment. Forcing a one-element-per-line layout, the DDIC-view name-list-adjacent layout concerns, and any comment-integration behavior are not implemented.

abapCleaner.rules.DDL_TYPO.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Correct frequent typos in DDL comments**

Currently corrects the same narrow, unambiguous typo-correction table used by the ABAP TYPO rule inside DDL/DCL comments only; adding TODO comments on suspect annotation values and British-to-American conversion are not yet handled.
